candidate.behavior: Reversible alpha-beta/PVS with proved non-king legality, stack-reused masks, count-only mobility, linked continuations, bounded tables, aspiration windows and history ordering; deep search; among equally scored moves, prefers the resulting position seen fewer times, while retaining a draw that avoids a worse score.

schedule: Candidate-white then candidate-black tasks; 6 seeds × 16 starts × 36 presets × 2 colors = 6912
notes: Fixed depth four, no time/node cap, no speculative options. Six fresh seeds, all 16 starts and both fixed engine colors on 36 shared production presets. Candidate and frozen Sharp v2 have independent seeded tie streams. Other historical research objectives/armies require their own compatible adapter and are not pooled here. Not an equal-time match or proof of non-inferiority.
